user.title: Add ASIC miner
user.description: Configure the economic inputs, miner entities, and measured operating curve.

data_description.name: Use a unique, recognizable name such as Antminer S9, S9i, or S19j Pro. This name is also used for the config-entry heading.
data_description.hashprice_sensor: Net hashprice in currency per TH per day, for example BCH Hashprice in €/TH/day.
data_description.electricity_price_sensor: Electricity price in the same currency per kWh.
data_description.hashrate_sensor: Live miner hashrate in TH/s. Used for current-performance sensors.
data_description.power_sensor: Live power in W. Prefer true wall power from a smart plug when available.
data_description.power_limit_entity: Writable number entity used to set the miner target power, for example hass-miner Power Limit.
data_description.curve: One line per measured point: target_w, actual_wall_w, hashrate_THs. Comments beginning with # are allowed.
data_description.min_power_change: Do not retune the miner unless the target moves by at least this many watts.
data_description.startup_wait: When Mining Request turns on, wait up to this many seconds for the miner power-limit entity to become available.

error.invalid_curve: Invalid curve. Use one line per point: target_w, actual_wall_w, hashrate_THs

abort.already_configured: This miner power-limit entity is already configured.

init.title: Configure miner profile
init.description: Rename this miner or update its measured power/hashrate profile and retuning behavior. Changes are applied after Submit and the integration reloads automatically.

data_description.name: This name is used for the ASIC Profit Optimizer config-entry heading and the optimizer device's default name.
data_description.curve: Edit or add rows as: target_w, actual_wall_w, hashrate_THs.
data_description.min_power_change: Minimum target change required before the optimizer retunes the miner.
data_description.startup_wait: Maximum time to wait for the writable power-limit entity after an external automation powers the miner.

error.invalid_curve: Invalid curve. Use one line per point: target_w, actual_wall_w, hashrate_THs
